# Termy

##### Code Assistant

Added on Nov 01,2026

thumbnail

## Description

Termy is a Mac app that puts the Claude Code and Codex AI coding agents in a terminal that drops down from the MacBook notch.

Hovering over the notch, clicking the menu bar icon or pressing a shortcut opens the terminal panel. Termy opens a tab for every project open in Xcode, VS Code or Cursor, and each tab starts the coding agent in the right project folder. [...] ## Termy Key Features

 Terminal for Claude Code and Codex that drops down from the MacBook notch
 Approve or deny agent commands from the notch with Allow and Deny buttons
 Live status read from the agents' hook events: working, needs you, or done
 Opens a tab for each project open in Xcode, VS Code or Cursor
 Resumes each tab's conversation after quitting, restarting or an agent crash
 Pro adds auto-checkpoints, git worktrees, split view and on-device Whisper dictation
 Also runs Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Amp, with status read from terminal output

## Termy Pricing

Free version costs $0 with one running session; Pro is a $4.99 one-time purchase with a 14-day free trial.

results.content:
Your AI agents, living next to the MacBook notch.

While Claude Code or Codex is working, its mascot walks beside the notch — the Claude Code banner critter for Claude, the official Codex pet for Codex. Each agent has its own slot: the moment one finishes, its mascot becomes a green blob (even while the other keeps working). The green is a "finished since you last looked" notification — focusing your terminal clears it. Click to open a panel of your sessions, grouped by prompt, with every subagent tucked under a dropdown.

Claude Code mascot and Codex pet walking beside the notch

Claude Code mascot and Codex pet walking beside the notch

## The panel [...] `ps`
`claude`
`codex`
`lsof`
`~/.claude/projects//.jsonl`
`<session>/subagents/agent-.jsonl`
`~/.codex/sessions//.jsonl`
`parent_thread_id`

Within a live session, busy vs idle is a hybrid: process alive + transcript written in the last 30 s = busy (mascot walks); alive but quiet = idle (nothing in the notch, dimmed row in the panel); process gone for 2 polls = done (green blob). Sessions idle over 6 h drop off the panel. Activating a terminal app (Ghostty, Terminal, iTerm2, kitty, Warp, Alacritty) acknowledges finished agents and clears their green indicator.
